description: This file defines a utility for formatting voice overlay text, including calculating deltas and creating attributed strings with styled committed and volatile parts.

methods.name: delta
methods.description: Returns the substring of 'current' that comes after the 'committed' prefix, or 'current' if it doesn't start with 'committed'.

methods.name: makeAttributed
methods.description: Creates an NSAttributedString combining committed and volatile text parts with appropriate styling, indicating whether the text is final or volatile.
